Most AI projects fail for a simple reason: people start with the model instead of the problem.

I specialize in problem-first AI/ML thinking. Before touching algorithms, I define the decision, the metric, and the behavioral change the system must drive. Models are tools. Clarity is leverage.

Over the past few years, I’ve built and deployed data-driven products that translate messy real-world problems into production-ready AI systems. My work spans classical machine learning, modern Generative AI systems, and end-to-end data product development.

On the Generative AI side, I worked with LLM-powered applications including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multimodal pipelines, conversational voice agents, and multi-agent orchestration systems designed to automate workflows and augment decision-making. The focus is not just prompting models, but designing reliable systems around them - retrieval pipelines, evaluation loops, and production integrations.

In parallel, I designed & built production-grade perception pipelines using OpenCV, PyTorch, and YOLO, optimized with GPU acceleration and distributed deep learning architectures. My specialization is detecting extremely small objects in complex environments using techniques such as slicing-aided hyper inference (SAHI), optimized NMS strategies, multi-object tracking, and segmentation-based refinement - solving a common failure case for standard detection models.

From experimentation to deployment, I design end-to-end ML systems using Python-based ecosystems including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and Keras, with production infrastructure built on AWS (SageMaker, CodeDeploy), Docker, and data systems such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.

Beyond building systems, I also design and teach AI/ML programs that emphasize problem-first thinking in a world obsessed with tools. My approach focuses on problem decomposition, decision-driven metrics, experimentation, and real-world constraints rather than purely theoretical model training.

If you are:
• a company exploring AI/ML solutions grounded in real business problems
• a training institute looking for applied AI/ML instruction
• a hiring manager seeking engineers who think in systems, not just models

We should talk 🙋‍♂️
Feel free to reach out at: saijeevan2002@gmail.com 

I believe AI is not about building smarter models. It’s about building sharper thinking!

nodes.role:
I build AI systems that have to survive contact with production — not demos, not pilots, not slide decks. 

For the last decade, that's meant leading GenAI and machine learning initiatives across Siemens' global businesses: architecting IQStack, a RAG and multi-agent copiloting platform for QA engineers; scaling GLADAPT, a forecasting and anomaly-detection platform that runs ~200,000 models a month across 35+ countries; and authoring the internal AI framework teams at Siemens now build on. 

What makes this different from most AI leadership: I never fully left the architecture. I set strategy and I still make the technical calls — because the two are inseparable once a system has to clear compliance, security, and real users, not just a benchmark. 

What I believe about AI: 
● Production reliability matters more than benchmark scores. 
● Great AI systems come from cross-functional teams, not isolated models. 
● Simplicity scales better than novelty — most of my hardest problems were solved by removing complexity, not adding intelligence. 
● AI should create measurable business outcomes. 

If I can't point to a number, I don't count it as shipped. 

What excites me right now - agentic systems that make real decisions inside enterprise workflows, and the governance and evaluation problems that come with letting them. Based in India, with three years building and studying in Germany (TUM Munich). Open to the right conversations.

Outside my day-to-day work, I write about building AI systems, share practical lessons from production deployments, and explore how AI products move from experimentation to enterprise adoption.

nodes.label: Eric Brattain-Morrin
nodes.role:
I build clinical AI for radiology from beginning to end, from the data and the clinical problem definition through model training and rigorous evaluation to optimized production deployment, and I lead others doing the same.

I came to this work from an unusual direction: a PhD in applied mathematics and five years as a tenure-track mathematics professor, before moving into industry machine learning a little over five years ago. Since then I've built production healthcare AI across four companies and most major imaging modalities: radiology foundation models and report generation at HOPPR (mammography, chest CT, head CT, and MSK X-ray); clinical NLP and LLMs at Cohere Health; dental-imaging detection and segmentation at VideaHealth (contributing to Dental Assist, a 30+ condition FDA clearance); and point-of-care ultrasound at Butterfly Network (including the FDA-cleared Auto B-line Counter).

What I care about is AI that actually lands in clinical workflow and earns clinicians' trust. That means getting the evaluation, the regulatory rigor, and the human factors right, not just the model. I'm a published contributor to radiology report-generation evaluation (RadEval), and I work closely with clinical, product, and software teams to translate between them.

Core areas: deep learning, computer vision, multimodal AI, representation learning, NLP and LLMs, generative AI, detection and segmentation, radiology report generation, model evaluation and biostatistics, and MLOps and inference optimization. Tools: Python, PyTorch, AWS.

Co-author of the book 'Sculpting Data for ML,' with over 600 citations for published research in NLP, deep learning, and applied ML at venues including RecSys, ACL, and KDD.

nodes.id: I:achanta sri surya srinivasa sai kiran
nodes.label: Achanta Sri Surya Srinivasa Sai Kiran
nodes.role: Technical Program Manager with over nine years in software, starting as an SDE-T before transitioning into TPM roles. Spent seven years at Amazon working on the Fire Tablets organization, most recently at Oracle.

nodes.label: Yadhu Krishnan Mundayodan
nodes.role: Lead Product Manager at Microsoft, working on AI and data platform initiatives that support teams across the organization, with over 14 years in product and engineering roles. Previously worked at Cognizant and Serco.

nodes.label: Avinash Modi
nodes.role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Roku, with research experience from IIT Bombay and prior roles at Gemini, Walmart, and Amazon as an Applied Scientist. Also a Subject Matter Expert and ML Instructor at Interview Kickstart.

nodes.label: Azeem Ghumman
nodes.role: Head of Engineering at Knowtex, an MLOps startup he co-founded that received seed funding from Alchemist Accelerator. Career includes stints at Blue Origin as an Avionics Software Engineer, as the first mapping engineer at Zoox, and on Amazon Scout and Amazon Flex.

nodes.label: Ajay Babu P
nodes.role: Senior Manager of Data Engineering at Epsilon, with 12 years of experience as a Business Intelligence Engineer, Data Modeler, and Data Engineer. Has worked at Accenture, Koch, Amazon, and Tesco, leading data pipeline and system design projects.

nodes.label: Mak Sampath
nodes.role: Senior Engineering Manager at Sam's Club, with prior experience as a Software Engineer at Google and Mobility Innovation Architect at Purdue Pharma.

nodes.label: Ankur Jha
nodes.role: Engineering Manager at Uber, previously leading the AI Platform Foundation team at Intuit's India Development Center. Career has spanned e-commerce, retail, fintech, and stock trading, including a Director of Engineering role at Angel One.

nodes.label: Siddharth Singh
nodes.role: Director of Engineering at Paytm, where he's spent around eight years and now owns engineering for verticals contributing over $50 million in monthly GMV. Holds a BTech and MTech from IIIT Gwalior and an Executive MBA from IIM Lucknow.

nodes.label: Waleed Ibrahim
nodes.role: Cloud Security Advisor and Virtual CISO at AWS, with over 20 years advising Fortune 100 and public sector clients on cybersecurity strategy. Founded and scaled security advisory practices at both AWS and Microsoft, with deep expertise in compliance frameworks like ISO 27001 and FedRAMP.

nodes.label: Ranjan Kumar
nodes.role: Subject Matter Expert in Data Structures and Python at Interview Kickstart, and a Computer Science teacher with the Bihar School Examination Board. Holds a BTech from GNDEC Ludhiana and has prior experience as an iOS developer.

nodes.label: Harsh Srivastava
nodes.role: Senior Frontend Engineer at Coupang, with over eight years of experience building data-intensive frontend applications at scale in e-commerce. Previously worked at Flipkart in India and Fabric in the US.

nodes.label: Yokesh Rana
nodes.role: Senior Software Engineer at PayPal, specializing in Agentic AI and LLM Engineering on the AI Assistance Platform serving millions of daily customer interactions. Previously worked on GPU-based neural network inference at Samsung Research.

nodes.label: Andres Padilla
nodes.role: Principal Applied Scientist at Microsoft, with over 20 years across GenAI, analytics, streaming data, and LLMOps. Leads transformative AI/ML initiatives and helps accelerate Azure adoption for customers across the Americas and Europe.

nodes.label: Mohammad Suaib
nodes.role: Consultant at Tata Consultancy Services, with a DevOps background spanning Nokia Global, Huawei, AT&T, and Proven Solution across the US and Middle East. Has published machine learning research in IEEExplore.

nodes.label: Soumya Mukherjee
nodes.role: Senior Principal Engineer for AI & ML Platforms at Apple, with over 18 years building production-scale RAG systems, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent frameworks. A former startup co-founder, with earlier experience as Vice President at Morgan Stanley.

nodes.label: Rajat Gupta
nodes.role: Senior Director of Data Science at Gartner, with 13 years of experience running ML workloads in production at scale. An IIT Kanpur alumnus with an Executive MBA, previously managed data science teams at Paytm and UnitedHealth Group.

nodes.label: Rituraj Singh Jodha
nodes.role: Principal Machine Learning Engineer at Atlassian, with over eight years building data science and ML solutions across cybersecurity, telecommunications, and media. Previously a Senior Data Scientist at Microsoft and Disney Star.

nodes.label: Arjun Sharma
nodes.role: AI Research Scientist in Reinforcement Learning and Post-training at AMD, previously a Machine Learning Engineer at Zoox working on planning algorithms for self-driving cars. Also researched at MBZUAI and worked as a Research Engineer at Alphabet.

nodes.label: Shih-Kang Chao
nodes.role: Senior Applied Scientist at Amazon, previously a Machine Learning Scientist at Health at Scale and a tenure-track Assistant Professor of Statistics at the University of Missouri. Has published in top venues including NeurIPS, ICML, and KDD.

nodes.label: Aarthi Srinivasan
nodes.role: Head of Gen AI at Docusign, previously an advisory board member at CoreThink AI. Action-oriented product leader with a track record steering product, design, and engineering teams.

nodes.label: Taha Bebek
nodes.role: Co-Founder and CEO of Wespoke AI, with prior experience as a Staff Software Engineer at Nextdoor, Senior Staff Software Engineer at Poshmark, and Senior Software Engineer at Meta.

nodes.label: Khalam Pugh
nodes.role: Technical Mentor and Agile Development Engineer at the California Department of Consumer Affairs, previously a Software Engineer at Rivian and Technical Instructor at Interview Kickstart.

nodes.label: Vinoth Kumar G
nodes.role: Lead AI Consultant at Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank, with prior experience as a Member of Technical Staff and Senior Software Engineer at PayPal, and Senior Software Engineer at Wells Fargo India Solutions.

nodes.label: Loveperteek Singh
nodes.role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Instacart, a BITS Pilani graduate with 7 years building ML solutions for search, recommendation systems, and generative AI at Myntra, Swiggy, and Apna.

nodes.label: Hien Luu
nodes.role: AI Advisor at Momento and Program Chair for AI Business Practices at UCSC Silicon Valley Extension, following runs as Senior Software Engineering Manager at Zoox and Senior Engineering Manager at DoorDash. Earlier led AI infrastructure and engineering teams at LinkedIn and Uber, and is a published author with Apress.

nodes.label: Pratik Shah
nodes.role: Director of Software and Algorithms at EnChannel Medical, leading a multidisciplinary team solving AI and imaging problems in healthcare. Holds a PhD from USC and previously worked as an Applied Scientist at Amazon.

nodes.label: Kevin Zhu
nodes.role: Machine Learning Engineer at Reddit, leading modeling work on the DPA conversions team, after ML engineering roles at Rokt and Meta. Also has experience as a technical mentor for Exponent and Leland.

nodes.label: Joey Robinson
nodes.role: Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI, focused on large-scale ranking and recommendation systems. Previously managed Web Ad Ranking at Snap Inc. and worked as a Machine Learning Engineer there.

nodes.label: Nishant Raj
nodes.role: Software Engineer at LightBeam.ai, a backend developer with a Computer Science degree specializing in Go, with prior experience at Omniful and Impact Analytics.

nodes.label: Mitchelle Rasquinha
nodes.role: Machine Learning Engineer at Meta, previously a Systems Engineer at Google for over 6 years and a Representative at MLCommons.

nodes.label: Yashasvi Kapur
nodes.role: Senior Associate Analyst at Amazon, with over five years of experience as a data analyst at MAANG companies. Also mentors data science and machine learning students at Great Learning.

nodes.label: Prashant Shukla
nodes.role: Principal Engineer at Saviynt, a software developer with 11 years of experience at companies including PayPal and Salesforce, specializing in backend development and system design.

nodes.label: Bareeha Dehradunwala
nodes.role: Technical Product Manager II at the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, with prior experience as a Technical Product Manager at Forterra and roles at Amazon in payment risk and technical recruiting.

nodes.label: Surendra Yearva
nodes.role: Senior Technical Program Manager at Amazon, with expertise in supply chain, wireless industries, and AWS-based architecture. Previously a Lead Systems Engineer at Comtech Telecommunications.

nodes.label: Rushi Vyas
nodes.role: Staff Software Engineer at Uber for more than seven years, having helped build the Uber Reserve product; previously spent six years at Amazon building software for fulfillment operations.

nodes.label: Brian Duimstra
nodes.role: Principal Software Engineer at Socratic, previously a Senior Software Engineering Manager at Microsoft. Specializes in front-end technologies and JavaScript for large-scale web projects.

nodes.label: Lucas Pinto
nodes.role: Software Engineer, Machine Learning at Meta, working in computer vision. Previously a Lead Software Engineer at doTERRA International after starting his career in general software engineering.

nodes.label: Steven Inouye
nodes.role: Senior Software Engineer at Right Pedal LendOS, previously a Software Engineer II at Amazon and a Frontend Teacher and Interview Coach at Interview Kickstart.

nodes.label: James Vance
nodes.role: Principal Machine Learning Engineer at Paylocity, previously a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Amazon. Has put models into production across online insurance, military simulation, and hotel pricing.

nodes.label: Bommepally Tarun Aditya
nodes.role: Principal Data Scientist at Verve, with over 15 years leading AI/ML strategy and data organizations. Previously AI Team Lead at Salesforce and Engineering Manager for Machine Learning at Arcesium.

nodes.label: Israel Miles
nodes.role: Software Engineer II at Audible with a passion for making mathematics and machine learning understandable and applicable. Previously at Microsoft, with a degree from the University of Colorado Boulder.

nodes.label: Viswanath Vankadaru
nodes.role: Senior Director of Engineering for Enterprise Data Technology at Capital One, with over 20 years of software engineering experience including 10+ years in leadership. Has built multiple data teams from the ground up, most recently leading Core Data & AI/ML engineering at Uber.

nodes.label: Vibhor Nigam
nodes.role: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data, ML & AI at Databricks, helping early-stage startups build and scale data and AI systems on the Lakehouse architecture. Previously a Data Scientist at Level.

nodes.label: Zhandi Liao
nodes.role: Manager, Business Intelligence at Amazon, supporting the North America Grocery Business. Previously a scientist developing drug targets via computational models, and taught graduate classes at UC Davis for over 7 years.

nodes.id: I:tanikella v s s pavan kumar
nodes.label: Tanikella V S S Pavan Kumar
nodes.role: Vice President, Applied AI/ML Lead at JPMorganChase, previously a Senior Data Scientist at Microsoft in Hyderabad with 10 years building and deploying ML models into production.

nodes.label: Pratap Ramamurthy
nodes.role: AI Specialist Customer Engineer at Google, helping enterprises transition from AI experimentation to production at scale. Has led technical strategy and AI adoption across Google Cloud, H2O.ai, and AWS.

nodes.label: Wen Li
nodes.role: Senior Product Marketing Manager for Expansion & Monetization at Dropbox, based in New York City, with an MBA from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.

nodes.label: Christer Antonsen
nodes.role: Technical Recruiter for Software Engineering and Forward Deployed Engineering at Candid Health, a healthcare revenue-cycle automation platform. Spent roughly four years at Meta recruiting senior and staff-level software engineers across ML/AI and mobile, with earlier talent acquisition experience at AWS and in the startup space.

nodes.label: Zeki Sherif
nodes.role: Software Engineer at Lacework, previously at AWS. Focused on backend engineering and cloud software.

nodes.label: Lakshya Khandelwal
nodes.role: Senior Manager of Machine Learning Science at Expedia Group, with over eight years building scalable ML products at Walmart, Adobe, and Samsung. Holds Bachelor's and Master's degrees from IIT Kanpur in Mathematics and Computer Science.

nodes.label: Christian Monson
nodes.role: Curriculum builder and instructor at Interview Kickstart, with a Ph.D. in Computational Linguistics from Carnegie Mellon University. Spent nine years as a machine learning scientist in industry, including five years contributing to Amazon Alexa, and runs the YouTube channel A.I. Talks.

nodes.label: Ahmed Elbagoury
nodes.role: Machine Learning Engineer at Instacart, previously spending seven years as an ML/Software Engineer at Google. Background combines academic ML research with practical industry and teaching experience.

nodes.label: Pokala Praveen Kumar
nodes.role: Vice President of Applied AI at JPMorganChase, with a Ph.D. from IISc Bangalore and over ten years spanning research and enterprise AI leadership. Has authored more than 25 research papers in venues including IEEE TPAMI, CVPR, and EMNLP.

nodes.label: Vidya Sagar Madireddi
nodes.role: Senior Software Engineering Manager at Salesforce, with 20 years building software and scaling engineering teams. Specializes in distributed systems, microservices, and agentic AI, with prior leadership roles at Blue Yonder and OpenText.

nodes.label: Sunil Kumar R
nodes.role: Vice President of Product Management at Sequoia, previously Senior Director of Product and India site leader at Smarsh. Over 18 years building high-tech products and leading full product lifecycles from V1 launch onward.

nodes.label: Siddhartha Paul
nodes.role: Lead Data Scientist at Meesho, with a Ph.D. in Operations Research from IIT Bombay. Previously led logistics optimization at Swiggy and A.P. Moller-Maersk, building low-latency, scalable solutions for hyper-local delivery.

nodes.label: Bharath Anand
nodes.role: Senior Quality Assurance Manager and Head of QA at Amazon, with over 20 years building and leading QA teams at Microsoft, Amazon, and TikTok. Focuses on applying AI to make testing faster, smarter, and more adaptive.

nodes.label: Sasmita Panigrahi
nodes.role: Associate Director of Analytics and AI/ML Lead Architect at UnitedHealth Group, with 12 years of experience across agentic generative AI, data science, deep learning, and cloud computing. Previously at Goldman Sachs, with a master's in computer science from IIIT.

nodes.label: Vidhyalakshmi B
nodes.role: Senior Product Manager for Google Maps at Google, focused on agentic AI applications for product and technical program management. Previously at PayPal, with a degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay.

nodes.label: Senad Cimic
nodes.role: Senior engineering leader with 17+ years at Amazon and Snap, now working as an independent engineering leadership mentor and coach, including as a mentor within Interview Kickstart's instructor pool. Previously Senior Manager of Software Development at Amazon and Manager of Software Engineering at Snap.

nodes.label: Andrew SuterMorris
nodes.role: Senior Systems Software Engineer at NVIDIA, a former senior tech lead at Microsoft and currently CTO of two related companies, PreNav and Forming AI, working in the generative AI image space. Holds a degree from the Colorado School of Mines.

nodes.label: Nitesh Gajanan Nikhare
nodes.role: Senior Software Engineer at Walmart Global Tech India, previously a Senior Member of Technical Staff at Oracle with about 6.5 years of experience at product-based firms. Holds a degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras.

nodes.label: Sourish Deb
nodes.role: Technical Program and Product Management Leader at Ingram Micro. Previously at Microsoft, with an MBA from the Stanford Graduate School of Business.

nodes.label: David Mackey
nodes.role: Principal Data Engineer at Providence with 6 years of data engineering experience and 5 years in analytics before that. Previously at Uber, with a degree from Brigham Young University.

nodes.label: Jiaqi Guo
nodes.role: Research Data Scientist at Meta. Previously at Amazon, with a degree from UC San Diego.

nodes.label: Rupanshu Janbandhu
nodes.role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Agiloft with about 5 years of experience in ML, previously at Blue Cloud where he trained a cohort of engineers in Python. Holds a degree from G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering, Nagpur.

nodes.label: Ashutosh Sanjay Verma
nodes.role: Software Engineer 2 at Ethos with a B.Tech in IT from IIIT Allahabad, building scalable backend and full-stack systems and working on distributed services.

nodes.label: Nicholas Cifranic
nodes.role: Senior Security Engineer at Airbnb, previously a Senior Security Engineer at Amazon specializing in infrastructure, cloud security, and IoT system protection. Holds a degree from Carnegie Mellon University.

nodes.label: Vaibhav Bagga
nodes.role: Engineering Lead at Persistent Systems, a machine learning engineer with 4 years of experience previously at American Express and Expedia Group, focused mostly on machine learning operations. Holds a degree from Delhi Technological University.

nodes.label: Chintaluru Shiva
nodes.role: Senior Product Manager at Microsoft, an AI product manager with a deep focus on innovation and impactful consumer experiences spanning social experiences and generative AI. Previously at Uber, with executive education from Harvard Business School.

nodes.label: Anirban Bhattacharyya
nodes.role: Data Science Instructor at Maven, previously a Senior Data Scientist at Pinterest with more than 10 years of experience in data science at companies including eBay, Google, and Dropbox.

nodes.label: Mohammad Shadab
nodes.role: Engineering Manager at PayPal, holding a Bachelor's in Computer Science Engineering and a work-integrated Master's in Data Science from BITS Pilani, and currently pursuing a PhD.

nodes.label: Mahak Ahuja
nodes.role: Senior Product Data Scientist at Adobe, previously a Senior Data Analyst at Walmart with a total of 6 years of experience. Previously also at Uber, with a degree from Jaipur Engineering College and Research Centre.

nodes.label: Gaurav Agarwal
nodes.role: Senior Director at JustAnswer, a product management practitioner and leader with two decades in technology spanning Amazon, Google, and Walmart. Holds a degree from Carnegie Mellon University's Tepper School of Business.

nodes.label: Arash Einolghozati
nodes.role: Spent 8 combined years at Meta and Amazon working on NLP, and is now at an early-stage startup. Taught as a PhD student at Georgia Tech.

nodes.label: Shikhar Gupta
nodes.role: Staff Data Scientist at Walmart Global Tech, a certified data science professional with 10 years of experience in advanced analytics, leading teams of data scientists and ML engineers. Holds a degree from IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

nodes.label: Marcelo H. Guerra Hahn
nodes.role: Professor at Lake Washington Institute of Technology, focused on helping students see and understand their data through computer and data science education. Previously at Microsoft, with a degree from the University of Washington.

nodes.label: Matthew Lee
nodes.role: DevOps/Site Reliability Engineering Instructor at Interview Kickstart with over 7 years of SRE experience and 12 years of total IT experience, having contributed to sophisticated infrastructure tooling. Previously at Amazon, with a degree from the University of Southern California.
